item.title: Rock Island City Council approves rezoning for 50-acre stretch by Illinois Route 92
item.description: Rock Island City Council voted Monday night to make more land along Illinois Highway 92 available for economic development. They unanimously approved rezoning about 50 acres south of 31st Avenue for industrial use. The area was originally zoned for nature conservation. item.title: Severe T'Storm Watch issued for Quad Cities late Monday night - large hail possible
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Severe T'Storm Watch for the Quad Cities and surrounding areas for late Monday night and early Tuesday morning. The watch goes until 3 a.m. The biggest threat comes from large hail late tonight.
